# HardwareAware_DesignSpaceExploration

**Domain**: Cross
**First mentioned**: auto-extracted

## Definition
A methodology that integrates circuit-level non-idealities (e.g., noise, mismatch, limited precision) into the architectural search process of SNNs, rather than treating hardware as an afterthought. Bridges the gap between theoretical SNN models and physical implementations, essential for reliable in-network neuromorphic processing.
